page_title: OVI 0-2 ESP | Oviedo v Espanyol 17/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.

90+5' Josip Brekalo (R. Oviedo) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Marko Dmitrovic tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
90+4' Oviemuno Ejaria (R. Oviedo) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
90+4' A quickly taken corner by R. Oviedo.
90+2' The shots on goal statistics – 2:9.

90+1' Josip Brekalo (R. Oviedo) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Marko Dmitrovic to get hold of the ball.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
89' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) latched on to an accurate pass deep into the box and attempted to fire the ball past the keeper, but the shot is way off target. What a miskick!
88' Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Mateo Busquets blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to R. Oviedo.
87' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jose Salinas (Espanyol) replacing Pere Milla.
82' 0 - 2 Pere Milla (Espanyol) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
81' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to substitute Ruben Sanchez and he is replaced by Omar El Hilali (Espanyol).
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Oviemuno Ejaria (R. Oviedo) comes onto the pitch for Santiago Colombatto.
80' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Ilyas Chaira walks off the pitch to be replaced by Alex Fores (R. Oviedo).
80' Substitution. Exposito did his best and is replaced by Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol).
77' R. Oviedo will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
75' Manolo Gonzalez prepares a substitution. Kike Garcia is replaced by Charles Pickel (Espanyol).
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tyrhys Dolan leaves the pitch and Antoniu Roca (Espanyol) comes on.
73' 0 - 1 Goal! Kike Garcia (Espanyol) is quickest to react to the rebound and stabs the ball into the back of the net. It's 0:1.
73' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Espanyol players have a reason to celebrate!
70' Espanyol score a goal, but referee Mateo Busquets has now indicated he wants to check if the goal can stand using VAR!
69' Ilyas Chaira (R. Oviedo) makes a good run with the ball into the box, but mishits his shot as it goes high over the bar.
67' Pere Milla (Espanyol) connects with a cross and powers a header goalwards, but his effort goes just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and R. Oviedo will have a goal kick.
65' Luis Carrion decides to make a substitution. Haissem Hassan will be replaced by Josip Brekalo (R. Oviedo).
65' Substitution. Federico Vinas (R. Oviedo) on for Salomon Rondon.

64' Haissem Hassan (R. Oviedo) dribbled past his opponents before finding himself in a great position to strike. But his low attempt from just outside of the box went straight towards the middle of the goal and Marko Dmitrovic made a comfortable save.
63' Clemens Riedel (Espanyol) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
62' David Carmo (R. Oviedo) trips an opposition player and Mateo Busquets signals a foul. Espanyol win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
60' Espanyol have been awarded a corner kick.
59' Alberto Reina (R. Oviedo) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
59' Kike Garcia (Espanyol) attempts to find Roberto Fernandez Jaen, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for R. Oviedo.
58' The attendance for today's match is 25625.

56' Pere Milla (Espanyol) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for R. Oviedo.
55' The corner is swung in but R. Oviedo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
53' Espanyol earn a corner.
53' Kike Garcia (Espanyol) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Aaron Escandell pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
51' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Espanyol.

51' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The ball goes out of play. Espanyol are awarded a corner kick.
49' Nacho Vidal (R. Oviedo) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
49' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
47' Alberto Reina (R. Oviedo) received a precise low pass and immediately unleashed a shot on goal. Unfortunately, he only found the left post.
46' Substitution. Luka Ilic is replaced by Alberto Reina (R. Oviedo).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+1' The end of the first half.
45' The foul by Santiago Colombatto (R. Oviedo) was seen by Mateo Busquets who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
45' Pere Milla (Espanyol) sends a direct shot in from the free kick that's in a promising position. The ball sails towards the right post, but the goalkeeper prevents a goal with a quick save.

43' Leander Dendoncker (R. Oviedo) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Mateo Busquets has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Espanyol have a free kick from a promising distance.
42' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
39' Santiago Colombatto (R. Oviedo) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
37' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) latches onto a cross inside the box and aims a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Aaron Escandell reacts superbly to deny him.

35' What a poor attempt! Santiago Colombatto (R. Oviedo) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes yards wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Espanyol will have a goal kick.
34' Kike Garcia (Espanyol) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the right post. His effort, however, is blocked by Aaron Escandell, who pulls off a stunning save!

32' Salomon Rondon (R. Oviedo) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball goes well wide of the right post!
29' Kike Garcia (Espanyol) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
27' Pere Milla (Espanyol) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
25' Haissem Hassan (R. Oviedo) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the left-hand post.
24' Salomon Rondon (R. Oviedo) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
22' Espanyol have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
21' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. Espanyol win a corner kick.
19' Haissem Hassan (R. Oviedo) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marko Dmitrovic intercepts the ball.
15' The R. Oviedo players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
12' What a wasted opportunity by Luka Ilic (R. Oviedo)! He unleashed a powerful low shot from the centre of the box, but Marko Dmitrovic makes a decent save to thwart him.
7' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) latches on to a cross on the edge of the box and fires a shot at goal, but his effort was blocked by one of the defenders.
5' Haissem Hassan (R. Oviedo) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
4' The ball is out of play and Espanyol manage to earn a corner.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Espanyol will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Mateo Busquets.
